message.content:
**Blues scale in the key of A**

| Note | Interval from previous note |
|------|-----------------------------|
| A    | —                           |
| C    | minor 3rd (3 semitones)     |
| D    | major 2nd (2 semitones)     |
| D♯ (Eb) | diminished 5th (blue note) (1 semitone) |
| E    | major 2nd (1 semitone)      |
| G    | minor 7th (3 semitones)     |

So the **interval pattern** (in semitones) is:

```
3 – 2 – 1 – 1 – 3
```

In other words, the A blues scale consists of the notes **A, C, D, D♯ (Eb), E, G**, which correspond to the intervals **root → minor 3rd → perfect 4th → diminished 5th (blue note) → perfect 5th → minor 7th**.
